name: Asian Woman

source.title: Original low-poly avatar mesh generated for Vox
source.creator: Vox project

notes: The repository contains the actual binary GLB asset at addons/asian-woman/asian_woman.glb.
This is an original stylized low-poly full-body avatar built from colored mesh geometry; it is not a photorealistic scanned character.
The current Vox GLTF parser renders static geometry only and does not implement JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 skinning or animation playback.
Facial morph targets are not included, so audio-driven viseme lipsync is not supported by this asset yet.
